summary: Missing config.default.toml causes config load failure
failure_scenario: Config::load() merges Toml::file("config.default.toml") which does not exist in the repo; when NEXORA_ENV is unset (defaults to development), figment.extract() fails and prevents any service from starting

When NEXORA_ENV=docker (set for all services in docker-compose.yml), code formats config_file as "config.docker.toml" but no such file exists; actual config files use patterned names like config.gateway-docker.toml, each service needs its specific config file

summary: DatabaseConfig default URL references old credentials
failure_scenario: DatabaseConfig::default() sets url to "postgres://nexora:nexora_dev_password@localhost:5432/nexora"; without explicit config or env overrides, services connect to old nexora database with wrong credentials instead of new nexora database, causing connection failures

summary: RedisConfig default URL references old password
failure_scenario: RedisConfig::default() sets url to "redis://:nexora_dev_password@localhost:6379/0"; without explicit config, services attempt to connect to Redis with old password, causing connection failures in development environments not using docker compose

summary: AuthConfig default audience references old nexora-api
failure_scenario: AuthConfig::default() sets audience to "nexora-api"; if auth is used without explicit config, JWT tokens validated with old audience claim either fail validation or accept tokens they shouldn't, potentially allowing unauthorized access

summary: S3Config default bucket references old bucket name
failure_scenario: S3Config::default() sets bucket to "nexora-workforce-documents"; without explicit config, workforce service references old MinIO bucket name, causing object lookup failures for documents stored under new nexora-workforce-documents bucket

summary: Gateway auth URLs reference old Keycloak realm name
failure_scenario: If the Keycloak realm was originally named 'nexora' and only got a prefix rename in config files (but the actual Keycloak realm still called 'nexora'), all API gateway authentication would fail — JWT tokens issued against realm 'nexora' would be rejected by the gateway configured for 'nexora'

summary: Database credential names updated to nexora
failure_scenario: External scripts, backup jobs, or monitoring referencing 'nexora_dev_password' or 'nexora-postgres' will silently fail to authenticate; new 'nexora_dev_password' and 'nexora-postgres' credentials must be updated in all dependent automation

summary: Removed cargo run alias for api-gateway
failure_scenario: The line `cargo run -p nexora-api-gateway` was deleted and replaced with `cargo run -p nexora-api-gateway`; anyone using the old alias in scripts or CI will get "command not found" errors and the gateway won't start, requiring update to the new command name

summary: Wildcard dependency policy may not be properly re-established
failure_scenario: If the `wildcards = "deny"` policy was altered (relaxed to `warn` or removed), previously-failing path dependencies would silently pass cargo-deny; conversely, if tightened, previously-passing deps would break the build. The supply-chain invariant may not be properly re-established.
